Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) is a Danish organizational body responsible for clinical quality development across the country's regions. It serves as the overarching administrative and professional authority for the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]] (DANIBD) [^src1]. RKKP was instrumental in the creation and ongoing operation of this national quality database, which was officially launched on October 1, 2022 [^src1]. 

As the publisher of the DANIBD annual reports, RKKP oversees the national monitoring of treatment quality for patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Denmark [^src1]. The organization employs key personnel who manage the database's strategic, analytical, and operational functions. For instance, [[anne-mette-falstie-jensen|Anne Mette Falstie-Jensen]] serves as an epidemiologist at RKKP, and [[jakob-riis|Jakob Riis]] works as a data manager for the organization [^src2]. Additionally, RKKP acts as the data controller authority (*dataansvarlige myndighed*) for the database, with staff such as Esra Öztoprak representing this compliance and quality role [^src2]. Through these efforts, RKKP supports the broader national initiative to systematize and improve IBD treatment in Denmark via cross-regional quality measurement, standardized coding, and evidence-based development.
